items.title: Open Thread: Luke Kornet stops to help a local motorist
items.content:

Nemec/NBAE via Getty Images) | NBAE via Getty Images	In the midst of summer, members of the Spurs are in Paris, France working out and visiting a national art museum. Keldon Johnson made an appearance at a summer basketball camp in Laredo, Texas. And this weekend, the Spurs are hosting a back-to-school at the Frost Bank Center.

Meanwhile, somewhere in San Antonio, Luke Kornet is moonlighting as a roadside assistant.

Way to go, Kornet! Well done! 👏🏻 

WATCH: Spurs' Luke Kornet helps out San Antonio motorist having car trouble 

LINK – https://t.co/SeIczd9hfu#nba#porvida#sanantonio#gospursgopic.twitter.com/MlVCRtmyj3

— JeffGSpursZone (@JeffGSpursZone) August 6, 2026A TikTok user posted this video of Kornet as he pulled over to help a motorist who was having car trouble. 

It seems no matter where Kornet is, he makes the day brighter. Good on ya, Luke.
